Pinned by test/test_downgrade_rebuild.py::test_upgrade_then_downgrade_restores_the_keyword and by a pool-wide sweep over all seven keywords. NOT CLOSED: nothing at this site.  The text it replaced read: The UPGRADE is faithful; the DOWNGRADE is not. `RemoveKeyword(CardKeyword.Ethereal)` (Apparition.cs:37) maps to `self.is_ethereal = False`, correct at level 1.
